title: 2. Give assembly edits successful expert placement traces
hypothesis: Successful expert state-action sequences expose nut-to-peg placement geometry that handoff summaries and parameter-level imitation do not communicate to the symbolic editor.

prediction.rationale: Compare trace-conditioned and summary-only edits of the same recoverable parent under identical search; +0.20 requires actual seating rather than another small progress change.

code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py (--assembly-study trace-edit-suite: handoff traces, summary-only vs trace edits in two blocks, matched 24-candidate searches)

falsified_by: Zero success in both trace-conditioned blocks refutes the proposed rescue. Otherwise, an interval whose upper bound is below +0.20 refutes the predicted magnitude; an interval containing zero is inconclusive about an advantage.

result.notes: Five learner-to-expert handoffs of the frozen recoverable parent on demonstration pool 3520: 1/5 expert continuations succeeded, so the trace arm saw one successful episode (every 4th post-handoff step). Both summary-only edits were valid and, after 24-candidate search, scored 0.00 (best probe 0.00). Both trace-conditioned edits failed validation on the same rule: gate_not_a_lever (they recorded new post-lift gates such as post_opened, placement_near and settled without using the returned values); the protocol allowed no correction, so by intention to treat both score 0.00. Trace minus summary-only: +0.000 [0, 0]. By the predeclared rule (zero success in both trace blocks) the prediction is refuted for the procedure as specified, but the trace treatment itself was never evaluated: the result is about edit validity, not about trace evidence. Note also that the expert completed only 1/5 handoffs here versus 0.67 in R-025. 305 episodes (5 demo + 240 probe + 60 promotion; invalid edits were not searched), 4 LLM calls.

verdicts.reasoning: By the predeclared rule (zero success in both trace-conditioned blocks) the prediction is refuted: trace minus summary-only is +0.000 [0, 0]. But both trace edits failed validation on gate_not_a_lever (recorded but unused post-lift gates), a formal defect that one correction would likely fix, and the protocol allowed none; so the trace evidence itself was never put to an autonomous test. Both summary-only edits were valid and scored 0.00, consistent with D-023.
verdicts.next_experiment: If trace evidence is still worth testing, rerun with one validity correction per edit (the standard pipeline allowance) on fresh seeds, and with more successful continuations (only 1/5 here). Otherwise move to the remaining hard tasks (R-030 or a scan of peg-insert-side, hammer, shelf-place, basketball, soccer).
